description: M7R R4d hitch route H-upload on m7_three_dense_all_visible_v1: fresh RGBA8 mip-chained textures uploaded mid-run (never sampled), sized to exercise the 64 MiB staging ring (8 x 1024: 45 MB in the ring), a batch larger than the ring (16 x 1024: 89 MB, the overflow uses dedicated staging), many small uploads (64 x 256), and dedicated staging for uploads above a quarter of the ring (2 x 2048, 1 x 4096). Compare --upload-queue legacy-blocking (A) with auto (B) on one build.
